title: Orion private deploy — 1:1 kick-forward notes
content:
Meeting: 1:1 kick-forward with Orion (customer) — weekly prep notes
Owner: Hannah Li (solutions eng) — scratchpad for meeting talking points, live notes, and follow-ups
Meeting window: Tue 2025-02-20 10:30 PT (30m) — prep items to cover before handoff to Marcel for infra deep-dive
Purpose: make visible where we are on the private (VPC/on-prem) rollout, surface short-horizon blockers, confirm owners and dates, and leave with a clear set of next actions that unblock the next milestone.

Quick context (TL;DR):
- Orion committed to a staged VPC + on-prem rollout to meet regulatory controls in EMEA.
- We finished baseline network design and preliminary acceptance tests on site image (2025-02-10).
- Remaining big items: KMS integration, host-level metrics/agent, and one critical perf regression identified on long-context chat workload.

Prep checklist (things to have in hand for convo):
- Latest acceptance test artifact (linked above). If asked, reference JIRA-ORION-421 test results (passed except perf regression).
- Short summary of KMS options and recommended approach (HSM vs cloud KMS). Draft recommendation attached in Confluence page.
- Cost/ops impact of running dedicated quantized model variant vs full FP16 on their 8xA100 cluster. (Lina to share rough $/hr numbers before meeting.)

Agenda (proposed for 30m):
1) 2m — quick status recap (what shipped since last sync)
2) 8m — unblockers deep-dive (KMS, agent, perf regression) — confirm owner and ETA
3) 8m — rollout sequencing and rollback/fallback policy (how we avoid a full cutover if regression persists)
4) 7m — action review + next check-in cadence
5) 5m — parking-lot and ad-hoc asks (security or procurement escalations)

Current milestones (live):
- M1: Network & image baseline validation — DONE (2025-02-10) — owner: Orion infra lead (Anna S).
- M2: KMS integration and key rotation test — target 2025-02-25 — owner: Redwood solutions (Hannah) + Orion Sec (TBD).
- M3: Host agent for metrics + log-forwarding in staging — target 2025-03-03 — owner: Marcel (infra).
- M4: Perf regression resolved & long-context smoke tests — target 2025-03-07 — owner: Research / Serving-runtime (Marcel + Priya).
- M5: Canary rollout in production VPC (2 nodes) — target 2025-03-14 — owner: Orion SRE + Redwood runbook lead (Lina).

Blockers (explicit) — what to escalate now:
1) KMS decision pending (customer procurement requires vendor vs cloud KMS approval). Consequence: no key material for private image encryption and audit logs.
   - Owner: Hannah to coordinate with Orion Sec and procurement.
   - Ask: schedule 30m decision meeting this week; need procurement contact and brief SOW for HSM evaluation.
2) Host metrics agent build failing on ARM node in their staging racks — causes missing dependency in RPM.
   - Owner: Marcel (infra).
   - Current plan: reproduce locally, cut patch, push image. ETA unknown (tracked JIRA-ORION-436).
3) Long-context perf regression on our quantized variant: token throughput drops ~30% at seq=8192. Suspected cause: KV cache partitioning + kernel scheduling misalignment.
   - Owner: Priya (applied-ml) + serving-runtime.
   - Impact: delays M4 and may force using full FP16 for canary (higher cost, lower headroom).

Decisions needed on call (clear asks):
- KMS path: HSM on-prem vs cloud-managed KMS — need Orion leadership sign-off this week.
- Canary fallback strategy: approve temporary FP16 mode for first canary if regression not fixed by 2025-03-07. Should we proceed? (cost estimate required)

Suggested talking lines (keep it concise in meeting):
- "We have the network baseline in place — the remaining work is mostly integration and one perf item. If we get KMS sorted, the rest is schedulable and owned."
- "If the perf regression persists, we can run FP16 for the first canary to keep dates, but cost will increase — need your approval now to budget for that contingency."

Action items (clear, owners, due):
- AI-1: Book KMS decision meeting with Orion Sec + procurement (Hannah) — due 2025-02-21.
- AI-2: Marcel to triage and provide patch for ARM agent RPM; post link to staging image in Slack (Marcel) — due 2025-02-24.
- AI-3: Priya to run focused perf repro and create a short bullet doc describing root cause hypothesis + quick mitigation (Priya) — due 2025-02-25.
- AI-4: Lina to prepare FP16 cost delta for one canary node (per-hour and 2-week estimate) and share in Confluence (Lina) — due 2025-02-23.
- AI-5: Hannah to draft a succinct email to Orion exec sponsor outlining options/fallbacks (Hannah) — due 2025-02-21 (will send after decision call).

Risks / notes to flag to customer:
- If procurement blocks HSM and we cannot provision KMS by M2, final sign-off for canary will slip at least 2 weeks. Need contingency approval.
- If we opt FP16 fallback, capacity headroom is reduced and we should advise on stricter rate limiting at first canary to avoid saturation.

Parking lot (things to discuss later or offline):
- License wording for on-prem telemetry (what counts as telemetry) — Lina + Legal to sync next week.
- Nightly auto-upgrade policy for security patches — propose opt-in for first 60 days, revisit for M5.

Quick draft follow-up email (copyable after call):
- Subject: "Orion private deploy — short outcomes and next steps (week of 2025-02-20)"
- Body bullet points: summary of decision(s), list of owners + due dates above, link to test artifacts, request for procurement contact + HSM eval SOW, ask to confirm whether FP16 contingency approval is acceptable.

Notes for me (Hannah) — talking etiquette:
- Keep tone collaborative; call out tradeoffs (cost vs time) not blame.
- If Orion escalates procurement timeline, offer a short-term hosted fallback plan (we can host a bridged RTP for 2 weeks) — price TBD.

Live meeting notes placeholder: (fill during call)
- Attendees:
- Agreed decisions:
- New action items (if any):

End of scratchpad.
